prompt: A long agent session is approaching the context window limit. What does compaction do?

options.text: It summarizes the conversation so far and continues in a new context window that starts from the summary.
It compresses the tokens with a lossless algorithm so the same text takes fewer tokens.
It raises the model's maximum context size for the session.
It moves the oldest messages into the system prompt unchanged.

explanation: Compaction replaces older turns with a summary and reinitiates the context from it, which keeps the active context small. The art lies in what to keep: overly aggressive compaction can drop subtle details whose importance only appears later.

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents (Anthropic)
